name: Data.card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp
summary: Count the columns as a telescoping sum of the row parameters.

steps.claim: Write |DetIndex j τ| as Σ_{h<k+j−1} k⁺(τ, h) + 𝗁′, and k⁺(τ, h) as differences of consecutive values of rowParameter(τ, l − 1) + max(l, 1) (sum_range_sub'); the telescoped sum plus bigCharExp j is w_j(τ) by the definitions of rowParameter, reducedHalfGap and auxPair (grind).
steps.lean:
open Finset in simp [← sum_range]; zify; rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl, sum_range_sub'
  fun l ↦ D.rowParameter τ (l - 1) + l ⊔ 1] <;> grind [rowParameter, reducedHalfGap, auxPair]
